# Church 244

> Kingdom Minded — A Christ-centered, Spirit-filled church community in Richland, Mississippi where you belong and you're family.

## Overview
Church 244 is a welcoming, Bible-believing Christian church located in Richland, Mississippi (serving Richland, Florence, Pearl, Brandon, and the greater Jackson, MS area). Led by Pastor Josh Watts and his wife Jeanette, Church 244 centers everything around Jesus Christ, Spirit-led worship, biblical teaching, and authentic family community. Come as you are — there is no dress code and our doors are always open.

## Location & Contact
- **Website**: https://church244.com/
- **Address**: 129 Center St, Suite F, Richland, MS 39218
- **Phone**: (601) 317-1482
- **Google Maps**: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Church+244/@32.2200422,-90.1572158,17z

## Weekly Service Times
- **Sunday Morning Worship**: Sundays, 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM (Main worship gathering with contemporary Spirit-led worship and biblical preaching)
- **Wednesday Bible Study & Fellowship**: Wednesdays, 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM (Fellowship and prayer starting at 6:30 PM, Adult Bible Study at 7:00 PM)
- **Church 244 Youth (Ages 13–19)**: Thursdays, 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM (High-energy teen worship, Bible study, and community)

## Leadership
- **Lead Pastor**: Pastor Josh Watts (with his wife Jeanette)
- **Praise & Worship Leaders**: Nick & Amy Hare
- **Youth Pastor & Wife**: Nick & Shanna Weeks
- **Children's Minister & Husband**: London & Andrew Perkins
- **Men's & Women's Ministry**: Matthew & Lexie Owens

## Ministries & Community
- **Men of God Monday**: Brotherhood, discipleship, and spiritual growth for husbands, fathers, and leaders
- **Women's Ministry**: Sisterhood rooted in Christ for encouragement, prayer, and walking through life together
- **Church 244 Youth**: Weekly Thursday night youth gatherings (ages 13–19)
- **Children's Ministry**: Christ-centered teaching and care for kids
- **Community Outreach**: Local family events and service in Richland, MS (including Easter outreach, Trunk or Treat, baptism celebrations, and testimony nights)
